risk_if_not_implemented: Without Developer Knowledge & Skills Register, essential knowledge and skills may be unavailable when needed, degrading the organization's ability to operate and protect itself. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Unreliable Assurance / Decision Information (R-GV-10), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Identify Critical Skills & Gaps
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to evaluate the critical security, compliance and resilience skills needed to support the organization's mission and identify gaps that exist.
compensating_control_1.justification: Identify Critical Skills & Gaps (HRS-16) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Developer Knowledge & Skills Register (TDA-19.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Role-Based Security, Compliance & Resilience Training
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to provide role-based security, compliance and resilience-related training: 
(1) Before authorizing access to the system or performing assigned duties; 
(2) When required by system changes; and 
(3) Annually thereafter.
compensating_control_2.justification: Role-Based Security, Compliance & Resilience Training (SAT-05) provides personnel training and awareness that compensates for the absence of Developer Knowledge & Skills Register (TDA-19.1) by equipping personnel with the knowledge and skills needed to recognize and respond to relevant threats. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
